_comment: An IAM deny policy, as shown in 3.17. Deny rules are evaluated BEFORE allow
policies and cannot be overridden by one, which makes them the only way to
subtract a permission from a grant inherited down the hierarchy (3.1).
The exception principal is a break-glass GROUP, not a person, and its use is
what the alert in 34.5 watches for. The denial condition scopes the rule to
production by tag, so a sandbox project is unaffected.
displayName: Deny deletion of production projects and folders
